text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Asked by Kitasan Black, I ended up joining 
her for dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: One, two, one, two! One, two—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wasshoi!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, shoot, I went and did it again!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... That's right. When I'm dancing, 
once the emotions really start surging 
through me—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I just instinctively shout out things like 
"Wasshoi!" or "Seiya!" without thinking!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
“If I shout like that during the actual 
race, though, it'll definitely catch the 
fans off guard, won't it...?”

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... What does everyone do when their 
feelings start overflowing like this, I 
wonder?
choice_data_list: If you're curious, why not ask?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I see! Um, to be more specific—
choice_data_list:
You wanna know how to make the most of 
those cheers, huh?

You want to know how to make the most of 
those cheers, don't you?
How to be cool, and stuff?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I see! Um, to be more specific—
choice_data_list:
You wanna know how to make the most of 
those cheers, huh?

You want to know how to make the most of 
those cheers, don't you?
How to be cool, and stuff?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Not stop it, but make use of it? How 
on earth would we do that...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Got it! Instead of doing it during the 
dance, I just have to do it before or 
after the song starts☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Even at Umadol Lives, we do 
call-and-response with the audience to get 
everyone hyped up☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You're going to turn the chant into a 
call-and-response?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: "Falco will give it a try!♪ Here I go~☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooo☆

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Heeeave-hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's amazing! Somehow I feel like 
Falco-san and I are totally in sync!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Right, right~☆ Umadols cherish their 
interactions with fans, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
By the way... hey, hey, Kita-chan♪ 
Don'tcha wanna hear more about Umadols? 
Falco can teach you anything and 
everything! ☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Smart Falcon's advice, my 
repertoire of performances has expanded 
greatly!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...A way to prevent one's emotional 
excitement from showing during a live 
performance, you say?"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for the sudden intrusion. The live 
concert of yours I saw before, Flash-san, 
was so flawless and amazing that—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"I just figured you were calmly keeping 
your emotions under control."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I see. If that is the case... let me see.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"First, I recommend we analyze where that 
excitement is actually coming from."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We cannot hope to solve this without 
knowing the cause. What kinds of 
situations get you excited, Kita-san?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's obviously whenever I feel someone 
cheering me on!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whenever someone calls my name in a loud 
voice, it makes me so happy, and I just 
want to thank them—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The cheers came from a place of gratitude. 
In that case, if they were to express it 
in a different way...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Understood! I'll try to focus on dancing 
in a way that conveys even more gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a clearer sense of the feelings she 
wanted to convey, Kitasan Black's dancing 
was further polished.
